scoring_justification: Full recompute of the Hopfield parameter from raw LAPW outputs is infeasible within the verifier sandbox; scoring uses result‑level comparison to paper‑reported gold within tolerance plus structural consistency checks (pd‑dominance and pressure trend).

outputs.description: Computed fluorine Hopfield parameter and pd-channel contribution for H3F at lattice constants 5.4 Bohr and 5.6 Bohr. The values will be compared to paper-reported results within a tolerance; structural consistency (pd dominance and pressure trend) is also verified.

output_contract.notes: The Hydrogen Hopfield parameter is computed but not scored; only the fluorine component is the primary target. Only the two LAPW runs and the GG formula post-processing are required; EOS fitting is skipped (pressure may be reported as null or deduced).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for fluorine Hopfield parameter from paper (Fig. 4 and text) and pd‑channel contributions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: eta_F=17.5 eV/Å^2 at a=5.4 Bohr, 13.9 at 5.6; pd=13.7, 11.3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper Section III and IV (Fig.4, pd‑channel description).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual reported results; the checker compares agent's computed values to these gold numbers with tolerance.
